name: blockchain-certificates
description: Hyperledger Fabric-based certificate verification system with traditional DB support

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:blockchain
scripts.dev:fabric: echo Configure and start your Fabric network in Ubuntu, then run the backend and frontend
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.blockchain:deploy:fabric: echo Package, install, approve, and commit the Fabric chaincode from blockchain/fabric/chaincode/certificates

author: Kapasa Makasa University
